sloka: हृष्टः प्रमुदितः सूतो जगामाशु विलोकयन् ।स सूतस्तत्र शुश्राव रामाधिकरणाः कथाः ॥२-१५-३०॥
transliteration: hṛṣṭaḥ pramuditaḥ sūto jagāmāśu vilokayan ।sa sūtastatra śuśrāva rāmādhikaraṇāḥ kathāḥ ॥2-15-30॥

translations.english: The charioteer heard the conversation relating to Rama and his consecration among the happy citizens.
